# Authoring templates

These files are reusable writing templates, not native GitHub issue or pull-request templates.

Native GitHub files live in:

- .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/
- .github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md

The blog, gist, task, and workflow-document templates are retained here because GitHub does not load them automatically. Do not copy them into ISSUE_TEMPLATE unless you intentionally want them to appear as issue choices.
